content: s3d v0.2.1 s3/preconditions.go (fetched raw 2026-10-21): CheckWrite returns ErrPreconditionFailed when IfNoneMatch matches current object; etagMatches treats condition '*' as wildcard matching any existing object, so If-None-Match:* + existing object => 412 PreconditionFailed; no current object => nil error (create succeeds). Source comment: 'A backend must call this in the same atomic operation as the write itself, so that of two concurrent writers only one can satisfy the same condition.' Conditional ops landed in 0.1.3 per CHANGELOG.
